record.question: At what temperature will both Celsius and Fahrenheit scales read the same value?
record.explanation: Answer D: -40° C or F. Set Celsius value equal to Fahrenheit: F=(9/5)C+32, so C=(9/5)C+32 gives C=F=−40. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/owm/si-units-temperature. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
